rationale: Shiza and Nitheesh both operate at the intersection of robotics and computer vision, with complementary expertise: Shiza brings hands-on hardware-software integration experience from 1X and is now building applied ML solutions at Haptile, while Nitheesh's staff-level research role at Nimble Robotics in manipulation and vision aligns with the technical depth needed for real-world robotics deployment. Their shared Python, vision, and ML foundations could unlock valuable perspective-sharing on bridging the gap between robotics research and practical industrialization.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Nitheesh Lakshminarayanappa — you both work at the intersection of robotics and computer vision, and Nitheesh's manipulation + vision research at Nimble could offer useful insights for Haptile's hardware-software integration challenges.
